藏品名称_EN: Bronze mirror, excavated from the Usa-Akatsuka burial mound in Buzen Province
藏品名称_ZN: 銅鏡（豊前国宇佐赤塚古墳出土）
描述_EN: Akatsuka Tomb is a 58-meter-long, front-circle, back-circle mound located on a plateau in Takamori, Usa City, Oita Prefecture, and was excavated in 1921. Five triangular-edged animals and animal mirrors, a pipe ball, and a fragment of an iron sword were found in the box-shaped sarcophagus in the center of the back circle, which was placed in an upright position. These triangular-edged animal and animal mirrors were made in China, making it one of the oldest burial mounds in Kyushu. The same mirrors have been found in the Ishitsuyama burial mound in Fukuoka Prefecture, the Tsubaki-Otsuyama burial mound in Kyoto Prefecture, and the Tsuno burial mound in Mie Prefecture, and their relationship has raised concerns.
描述_ZN: 赤冢墓是位于大分县宇佐市高森的高原上的一座长约58米的前圆后方的墓冢，于1921年发掘。在后圆中央的箱形石棺中发现了5个三角边的动物和动物镜、一个管球和一把铁剑碎片，该石棺被竖立放置。 这些三角形边框的动物和动物镜子都是在中国制造的，这使得它成为九州最古老的墓冢之一。 在福冈县的石津山墓冢、京都府的椿大津山墓冢和三重县的堤野墓冢中也发现了同样的镜子，它们之间的关系引起了人们的关注。
